label: preparing
what: Builder and innkeeper are organizing a service-anniversary surprise at the eighteen o'clock great-hall hospitality meeting, apparently celebrating my forty years as mayor. It was intended to be secret, although the secretary has now explicitly told me. Preparations include eight installed lanterns and bulk bread supplies; innkeeper coordinates further supplies. Secretary knowingly assists with arrangements and escorting me; freight was seen delivering bread to a hall table chest. Baker's knowing involvement is not established merely by bread purchases, nor is neighbour's.
